minutes.headline: Planning Board endorsed an ANR plan for 995 Reservoir Road and approved the 39 Main Street site plan with added conditions.
minutes.summary: The board endorsed an ANR plan moving a parcel to a lot on Fire Road 16, closed the 39 Main Street hearing and approved the site plan with a sidewalk condition and set construction hours. It then discussed master plan committee composition, committee reports, and the director's items on small-business permitting and change-of-use site plan approval. Minutes were approved and the meeting adjourned.

budget_items.topic: Municipal building design committee: price per square foot for town meeting
budget_items.what_was_said: The committee is considering dividing an earlier price tag by the square footage of improved buildings to give town meeting a number.
A member said the air conditioning cost is much higher than expected, but most of the work could be done for the earlier figure.
The economic development committee heard that a site preparation grant came through and could improve traffic flow on Reservoir Road.

budget_items.topic: Village Center remote parking design and construction funding
budget_items.what_was_said: Funding for construction designs was removed at town meeting, and construction funding was never proposed.

decisions.decision: For 39 Main Street the board settled on construction hours of seven to five Monday to Friday, eight to three Saturdays, and none on Sundays or holidays.
Conditions were added for 39 Main Street: sign-off on two engineer review items, and no construction vehicles obstructing the public sidewalk.
Master plan committee composition stays on the agenda for at least another meeting for feedback, including a possible library trustee seat.
No change to the change-of-use site plan rules before the new Building Commissioner starts on the 22nd; it is left for future discussion.

what_happened.line: The Planning Board approved the 39 Main Street site plan with two added conditions and set construction hours; the vote count was not audible in the captions.
Added conditions for 39 Main Street: sign-off on two engineer review items, and no construction vehicles blocking the public sidewalk.
Construction hours for 39 Main Street were set at weekdays and Saturdays only, with none on Sundays or holidays.
A motion to endorse the ANR plan for 995 Reservoir Road was made; the result was not audible in the captions.
Master plan committee composition was not resolved and stays on the agenda, with a possible library trustee seat raised.

why_it_matters: The conditions on 39 Main Street (sidewalk access, set work hours) govern how construction affects neighbors and pedestrians on that street.
The makeup of the master plan committee decides who helps shape the town's long-range land use plan, and it is still open for input.
Committee reports touched on a per-square-foot price for town meeting and air conditioning costs at the primary school, items that may reach a future town meeting vote.
